purpose: Independent finite-shot calibration fixture for distribution comparison
structure_note: Four-qubit scrambled-uniform preparation with a paired CNOT topology; not copied from the Bell, GHZ, parity, QFT-like, Toffoli, or ring-cluster fixtures.

proposed_next_calibration_plan.scope: Select a candidate finite-shot method on calibration data, then evaluate it once on untouched validation data. These targets do not alter the frozen Phase 5 contract.
proposed_next_calibration_plan.confidence_rule: One-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson bounds, computed separately at each shot count and stratum.
proposed_next_calibration_plan.candidate_test: Two-sample categorical TVD permutation test, alpha 0.05, with 999 Monte Carlo resamples and add-one p-value correction. The current implementation shuffles the pooled per-shot label vector; that implementation has only been exercised at pilot scale. Benchmark/optimize permutation post-processing before this plan is authorized.

design.seed_derivation: Four globally disjoint namespaces. For each split, derive template seeds as template_seed_root + template_index. Derive sampling seeds as sampling_seed_root + 10000*stratum_index + 10*template_index + shot_index. Use a distinct sample seed for each shot count; reject duplicate circuit fingerprints across splits.

specified_by_existing_evidence.identical_control: submitted circuit is exactly the reference circuit
specified_by_existing_evidence.measurement_equivalent_control: pilot inserts z on qubit 3 immediately before measurement

subtle.operation: replace first h on qubit 0 with ry

moderate.operation: replace first h on qubit 0 with ry

large.operation: replace first h on qubit 0 with ry

specified_by_existing_evidence.pairing: Reuse the same generated reference template across all five strata and all shot counts within a split. Change only the submitted-circuit intervention. This follows the plan requirement that each template contribute at every shot level and stratum and the paired pilot examples.
specified_by_existing_evidence.fault_target_mapping: Keep qubit 0 fixed as the fault target. Each generated reference must retain exactly one H on qubit 0; replace that H with the registered RY intervention. The pilot examples use H(0) as the first operation, but the intervention is defined by gate identity and qubit rather than list position.

primary_recipe.algorithm: Initialize numpy.default_rng(template_seed); use H in order 0,1,2,3, then CX(0,2), CX(1,3), then append RZ(q, angle[q]) for q=0..3 with four angles drawn uniformly from [-pi,pi), then measure all qubits.
primary_recipe.rationale: Owner decision made now: preserve the exact paired-CNOT topology in the original pilot. Terminal RZ phase tags provide deterministic distinct templates while preserving the pilot's uniform computational-basis distribution. The fixed topology is the primary preregistered recipe; this decision does not claim that phase tags are the only scientifically valid template construction.

candidate_recipes_for_comparison_only.algorithm: Initialize numpy.default_rng(template_seed); draw an H-qubit permutation; choose uniformly among the three perfect matchings of four qubits; draw CNOT pair order and each edge direction; append four seed-derived terminal RZ angles from [-pi,pi); then measure all qubits.

design.separation: Use calibration split only for method/threshold selection. Freeze method, threshold, and configuration hash before opening untouched validation. Never reuse validation outcomes for tuning; if changed after validation, require a new untouched validation split.
design.uncertainty: Report exact binomial intervals per shot and stratum. Also report template-paired differences across shot levels; do not pool shot counts. Each template contributes one result per shot level and stratum.

workload.arithmetic: 2 splits * 5 strata * 120 templates * 2 sampled circuits * (256 + 1024 + 4096) shots
workload.runtime_scope: Estimate uses the measured 1,774 shot-circuit-executions/second pilot rate and includes approximately 5-10 minutes extrapolated permutation work. Assumes sequential streaming and similar four-qubit circuit cost; allow uncertainty for generated circuit depth and host load. Earlier 55-75 minute estimate was low because its pilot execution count was double-counted.
workload.memory_note: Stream one small circuit comparison at a time; retain only per-configuration metrics and fingerprints. The largest pooled-label vector at 4096 shots is 8192 int64 entries (64 KiB), with a similarly sized permutation temporary; estimated permutation working set is below 1 MiB per active comparison, excluding Python/runtime baseline.

proposed_next_calibration_plan.phase5_non_change: Phase 5 sensitivity >=0.80, specificity >=0.90, fixed 0.05 threshold, and finite-shot guard remain unchanged. These proposed calibration targets are separate and stricter in some strata.
